newsitem.title: MACAU: Chinese foreign minister to visit Portugal in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Chinese foreign minister to visit Portugal in Jan.

text.p: Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen will visit Portugal from January 18-21, the Lusa news agency reported from the Portuguese-administered enclave of Macau on Wednesday.
Qian was invited by Foreign Minister Jaime Gama, who visited China in February, the Portuguese agency quoted a diplomatic source as saying.
It said Qian was expected to meet President Jorge Sampaio and Prime Minister Antonio Guterres in Lisbon.
Macau reverts to Chinese sovereignty in December 1999 after more than four centuries of Portuguese rule.
